correctness.rationale: The lower bounds \(3\) and \(4\) follow from the published statement that \(\operatorname{dirloc}(Q_n)\) is either \(n\) or \(n+1\). For the upper bounds, the packaged verifier reconstructs the literal legal response set for every currently possible robber vertex, groups all simultaneous response tuples into exact consistency classes, and checks every branch of the supplied policies. Every nonsingleton class is expanded by the exact closed-neighborhood stay-or-move rule before the next policy state. The exhaustive certificate has \(4\) state-budget pairs for \(Q_3\) and \(27\) for \(Q_4\) and covers \(81\) and \(1790\) legal response tuples, respectively. No inference for \(n\ge5\) or from finite experiments to an infinite family is made.
